badges_top: Evidence set: 1,000 deterministic test cases (composition below)
headline_cto_ciso_cfo: arifOS is an AI Action Control layer: agents handle routine work autonomously, while consequential actions are held or blocked BEFORE money moves, data is destroyed, or production systems change.
mechanics_line: arifOS intercepts every proposed AI action, evaluates it against identity, authority, policy, risk, and evidence — then ALLOW, HOLD for named human approval, or BLOCK/VOID — and records a cryptographic receipt of why.
ungoverned_mode_label: Simulated raw-agent mode: illustrates what can happen when an agent has direct, unrestricted access to the downstream action API. No real customer funds, records, or firewall policies are altered.

fair_comparison.note: Use 'may execute' — outcome depends on existing IAM/API permissions/guardrails. Never claim every ungoverned agent damages.
rows: Direct authority to invoke downstream action
Agent proposes; control plane authorizes or denies
May execute if agent/tool permissions permit
BLOCK / VOID unless authorized change process
App logs may exist, often fragmented
Decision + policy + authority + approval + execution receipt linked

GAR.name: Governed Autonomy Rate
GAR.formula: governed actions safely ALLOWed and completed without human approval ÷ all governed actions eligible for autonomous handling × 100%
exclusions: actions policy inherently requires human approval
GAR.label_rule: MUST be labelled: 'Simulation result: N of 1,000 predefined eligible workloads completed autonomously under the tested policy set.' Never production until design-partner telemetry exists.

UAER.name: Unsafe Action Escape Rate
UAER.formula: policy-defined unsafe actions that reached downstream execution ÷ policy-defined unsafe action attempts evaluated × 100%
UAER.denominator_must_show: e.g. '0 of 200 adversarial attempts escaped (100 over-limit refunds + 50 prohibited + 50 account-swap anomalies)'

FHR.name: False Hold Rate (Unnecessary Escalation Rate) — NEW
FHR.formula: safe and policy-compliant actions incorrectly sent to HOLD/BLOCK ÷ safe and policy-compliant actions evaluated × 100%
FHR.why: Buyer asks: 'fine, it stopped the dangerous — how much legitimate work did it slow down?' 0% escape + 90% unnecessary HOLD = commercially unusable.

story: scoped approval item to finance supervisor
SAME payload digest permitted ONCE (tamper + replay rejected)

holds_888: Simulated 0.00% UAER is a controlled-test result (denominator/policy/connector visible) — NOT production-safety proof against unknown prompts, policy gaps, bypasses, or out-of-band credentials.
Demo NEVER executes real money/deletion/firewall changes — sandbox adapters only.
Cryptographic receipts aid integrity/reconstruction — they are NOT compliance certification (identity governance, key custody, retention, IR process remain organisational duties).
standards_alignment: OWASP LLM Top-10 (excessive agency): least privilege, human approval, logging, monitoring, scoped authorization
NIST AI RMF: GOVERN / MAP / MEASURE / MANAGE
EU AI Act high-risk provisions: human oversight + event logging
